title: Formats v1
description: Shared formats every contract refers to with $ref (ops/QUESTIONS.md CQ-09, default in use until the CTO rules: ids, money and times). Written inside the model API's structured-outputs subset (02-contracts section 2 item 7), so a model-facing schema may refer to them: no number, length or count limits here; those are code checks.

id.title: Id
id.description: An opaque id: a non-empty string that code compares as a whole and never parses (CQ-09: 'other ids opaque strings').

turnId.title: TurnId
turnId.description: A turn's id: a hash of the event ids of the texts it joins (CQ-09; architecture 01 line 59). The hash itself is computed in code; to the schema it is an opaque, non-empty string.

bundleId.title: BundleId
bundleId.description: A bundle's id: a content hash of the compiled files plus a build number (CQ-09; architecture 01 line 87; tour line 658: every published bundle stays readable for replay). The hash's algorithm and spelling belong to the bundle contract (K-01).

hash.description: The content hash of the bundle's compiled files (CQ-09).

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: A currency code: three capital letters, as ISO 4217 writes them, for example USD (CQ-09: 'money in integer cents with a currency code').

money.title: Money
money.description: An amount of money: whole cents with its currency code, never a decimal (CQ-09). Whether an amount may be zero or negative is each field's rule, checked in code.

cents.description: The amount in the currency's cents, as an integer (CQ-09).

utc.title: Utc
utc.description: An instant in UTC, written as an RFC 3339 date-time ending in Z, for example 2026-11-07T15:30:00Z (CQ-09: 'every time in UTC'). Whether the date exists is a code check.

zone.title: Zone
zone.description: An IANA time zone name, for example America/New_York (CQ-09; S13-03: a visit's time is read in the visit's zone). Whether the zone exists in the IANA database is a code check.

time.title: Time
time.description: A time: the instant in UTC together with the IANA zone it is shown and reasoned in (CQ-09: 'every time in UTC with its IANA zone'; S13-03).
